## Definition of Done

### Code
- [ ] Compiles with zero errors and no new warnings
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion on the linked issue is met
- [ ] No commented-out code, no leftover debug printing
- [ ] The pattern is used where this week's UML says it is

### Tests
- [ ] New behaviour has at least one test
- [ ] `mvn test` green locally
- [ ] CI green on this PR

### Documentation
- [ ] Comments explain WHY, not what
- [ ] This week's UML updated to match the code
- [ ] README updated if visible behaviour changed

### Process
- [ ] Work done on a feature branch, not directly on main
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Self-reviewed the diff before requesting merge
